description: TXN-VIEW, the refresh boundary (r-fix-cat-txn/txn-view-readers-late had a single 7 s sample). Process b holds a snapshot, dynaset and table cursor over rows 1, 2, 64 opened before a's transaction; a BeginTrans, updates N of row 1 (+1000) and CommitTrans. b then, at cumulative 0.5, 2, 4, 5.5 and 7.5 s, does Move 0, reads each held cursor and a new snapshot of row 1 (every look is an observation that may itself refresh), then Idle(dbRefreshCache) and one more look; b then sets dbPageTimeout to 1000, opens a second held set, a commits another update, and b looks at 0.3, 0.7, 1.2, 2 and 4 s, then Requery on the snapshot and dynaset. Asks where each cursor kind first shows the committed value and whether dbPageTimeout moves the boundary.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-cat-txn-lock probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
